title: Paolo Ballesteros gives away salary to ‘Drag Race PH’ staff, says KaladKaren
summary: Kaladkaren expressed admiration for Paolo Ballesteros as she revealed that the latter gives back to the staff they work with in “Drag Race Philippines” by raffling off his salary every finale.…

blocks.text: Kaladkaren expressed admiration for Paolo Ballesteros as she revealed that the latter gives back to the staff they work with in “Drag Race Philippines” by raffling off his salary every finale. Kaladkaren, whose real name is Jervi Wrightson, took to X on Saturday, Oct. 3 to praise Ballesteros for his generosity. “Yung sahod niya every finale, pinapa raffle sa staff. Ganyan siya ka generous,” Kaladkaren said, replying to a fan’s thread about the things they admire about Ballesteros.
